thread:
elaine_cs: Heads up: we're seeing onboarding webhook timeouts for ~45m in ap-southeast region. New tenants stuck in "pending" and some setup webhooks returning 504. Collecting impacted list now.

harry_ops: confirmed elevated 504s from our delivery proxy, upstream CRIT_ERRORS increased after the midnight deploy. Investigating proxy config and connection pool exhaustion.

sana_eng: can you share a failing request id? I want to check retry headers and duplicate provisioning flags.

harry_ops: example req r-20260326-31ab. traces at https://internal/logs/req-31ab (redacted). repro curl: `curl -i -X POST https://hooks.prod.ap.example/provision -d '{}' --max-time 2`

deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-20260326-04  Onboarding webhooks 504 (ap-southeast). Bridge: https://bridge/INC-20260326-04

marta_support: I9ll start triaging accounts by onboarding status and priority. Uploading CSV to drive and DMing enterprise list to AMs.

elaine_cs: Draft outbound (short):
```
Hi <customer>,
Were investigating onboarding delays in AP-Southeast affecting tenant activation and webhook responses (some attempts returned 504). Engineers are working on a fix; no action required from you. Well update within 1 hour with ETA and follow up with details and credits if impacted.
```

marta_support: suits me. For enterprise I'll add meeting offer + SLA note.

harry_ops: mitigation plan: increase proxy pool, roll back risky midnight change, and pause retries for webhooks to avoid duplicate provisioning. Implementing now.

sana_eng: once proxy pool increased we should see inflight down. I'll add a temporary header to mark replays so we don't double-provision.

elaine_cs: propose credits: trials = 2 extra days; paid = 3% invoice credit if activation delayed >2 hours; enterprise = AM review + credit. Finance sign-off pending.

marta_support: uploading impacted list: https://drive/impacted-ap-20260326.csv and pinging AMs.

harry_ops: quick update: pool increased at 04:22; 504 rate down 90%. ETA queue clear ~20m.

elaine_cs: thanks team. I'll send outbound to affected trials/paid at +30m and coordinate enterprise outreach. Post-mortem owners: comms=@elaine_cs, mitigation=@harry_ops, RCA=@sana_eng.

marta_support: monitoring replies and will surface any customers needing manual intervention.
